justification: Versions the precinct-boundary health check (scripts/verify_precinct_boundaries.py was untracked working-scripts territory; .gitignore gains an explicit exception like the other permanent QA artifacts) and adds three City of Sydney KNOWN_POINTS spot checks for the 145 boundaries that went live today, plus one centroid exception (2.13.9 L-shaped corridor+park). No serving-path or pipeline code changes; the script is read-only against the DB.

pre_impl.existing_data: Script existed since the 2026-07-28 Waverley session but scripts/ is gitignored wholesale; exceptions pattern already used for pr_overlap_guard, xref_*, hub_scrapers. CoS coords geocoded independently via SIX Address_Location (not derived from the polygons being tested); '60 Martin Place' omitted because SIX returns the 53-63 odd-side range.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If SIX coords were wrong the new spot checks would fail loudly, not pass silently; all three verified passing against production before commit.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Additive only: 3 KNOWN_POINTS entries, 1 CENTROID_EXCEPTIONS entry, 2 comment lines, 1 gitignore exception. No logic changes.

queries: No SQL changed; script remains read-only SELECTs.

break_it.scenario: The CoS boundaries are later reloaded with shifted geometries (e.g. wrong SRID) and the reload forgets to re-verify.
break_it.what_happens: The three CoS spot checks fail with exit code 1 the next time the script runs - which is the point of versioning it.
break_it.how: Script is now tracked and referenced from the boundary worklist doc as the mandatory pre/post-import check.
break_it.repro: Shift any CoS boundary by 0.01 deg and run the script.

break_it.scenario: A clone without .env runs the script.
break_it.what_happens: Pre-existing behaviour: KeyError on SUPABASE_DB_URL - unchanged by this PR, config comes from repo-root .env.
break_it.how: Out of scope; documented in the script docstring usage.

post_merge.secrets: None - script reads DATABASE_URL from .env, no values committed.
post_merge.manual_verify: Run python scripts/verify_precinct_boundaries.py - expect PASS with 11/11 spot checks.
